params.body:
One commit on top of main (#2 is merged).

## The live site's filters, in the Stocklist dealer pattern

Schoutteet likes the filters of the current two S widget. This brings every filter that has data behind it, laid out the way the Stocklist dealer sites do it.

**Data.** The DMS carries more than the first import stored. The source now keeps the model family (Actros, TGX), the wheel formula (from the type text, `6x2-4`, else the master-data id), the axle count, the cab (from the equipment texts: Kz., Mtlg., Lg. Haus; Fernverkehr), the suspension (Blatt, Luft, Blatt-Luft) and one year per vehicle (first registration, else the DMS build year). Features are detected deterministically from the DMS flags and equipment texts with the taxonomy's own hints, so the facets are filled on import without the AI step; five features added (PTO, sleeper cab, air suspension, diff lock, all-wheel drive). On today's stock: wheel formula on 1.206 vehicles, cab on 1.035, suspension on 1.512, year on 2.189, model family on 1.472; features such as crane 307, steered axle 222, lift axle 263, retarder 186.

**Panel.** Type (body type within the category), make and model (model appears once a make is chosen), each with counts; year and mileage as dual-range sliders with a histogram; price and power from/to; the rarer filters under "Meer filters": euronorm, transmission, wheel formula, axles, cab, suspension, VAT-deductible only, with photos only, and the features grouped. Active filters are chips above the results, each removing only itself, plus "Wis alles"; the make is a chip too. On small screens the panel opens from a Filters button. Every filter is a plain query parameter, so URLs stay shareable; the live filter keeps working without a reload, including the model select that follows the make.

**Not in the widget's list but asked for by the data:** nothing dropped. The widget's fields without data in this stock (operating hours, doors, seats, gross weight, payload, the car-type checkboxes) are left out; the API has no weight or payload field.

**After merge:** `php artisan migrate --force`, then `php artisan vehicles:import --source=api --prune` once so the new columns and features are filled (the hourly sync does it anyway within the hour).

Tests: 4 feature tests for the panel (facets, model select, every filter narrowing the list and its chip, chip URLs), unit tests updated for the new fields. Checked in a headless browser on the real stock: make, model, year slider, feature checkbox, chip removal, mobile toggle, no script errors.
